summary: Validated live RoadLens backend APIs and mobile web inspection flow. All four authenticated API regression tests passed; dashboard navigation and AI analysis rendered successfully.
action_items: Investigate the logged GPT-5.4 integration warning ('str' object has no attribute 'text'); current inspection success relies on fallback behavior when the provider response shape differs.
Consider removing backend hardcoded configuration defaults so missing MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT settings fail fast per environment contract.
Add stable testID attributes to the Demo Role Switcher modal options to make role-switch automation reliable.
critical_code_review_comments: Status endpoint permits authority transitions without validating the current state, so out-of-order lifecycle changes can be accepted.
Resolution evidence is described as enforced but the implementation accepts resolution without repair image or URL.

Frontend client uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the current .env supplies the public variant, but deployment consistency should be clarified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for executed dashboard -> inspection -> AI analysis flow

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed complaint and inspection through the API regression test; no cleanup endpoint was available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Expo web preview loaded at mobile viewport. AI analysis returned a result and complaint/lifecycle API paths passed. Role switch modal uses labels 'Field Engineer (AUTHORITY)' and 'City Director (ADMIN)' rather than plain role text.
rca_of_issue: Provider integration logs show LlmChat.send_message returned a string-like result while server.py expects response.text, triggering the fallback analysis path. This did not break the endpoint, but means GPT-5.4 Vision output and true image-derived bounding boxes were not verified in this run.
